_meta.note: Practice codes and taxonomy structure follow MindForge. Summaries are original AIGP wording, not verbatim publication text.

risks.title: Discriminatory outcomes across customer segments
risks.summary: Model decisions systematically favour or disadvantage comparable customers in protected or sensitive groups.
risks.description: Fairness & Bias risk: Model decisions systematically favour or disadvantage comparable customers in protected or sensitive groups. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Proxy discrimination through correlated features
risks.summary: Seemingly neutral input variables act as proxies for protected attributes and drive unequal treatment.
risks.description: Fairness & Bias risk: Seemingly neutral input variables act as proxies for protected attributes and drive unequal treatment. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Feedback-loop amplification of historical bias
risks.summary: Training on past decisions reinforces existing disparities as the model learns from biased historical outcomes.
risks.description: Fairness & Bias risk: Training on past decisions reinforces existing disparities as the model learns from biased historical outcomes. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Unequal error rates across population subgroups
risks.summary: The model performs materially worse for some customer segments, creating disparate impact even when average accuracy appears acceptable.
risks.description: Fairness & Bias risk: The model performs materially worse for some customer segments, creating disparate impact even when average accuracy appears acceptable. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Generation of harmful or offensive content
risks.summary: The AI system produces toxic, abusive or socially harmful outputs when prompted or under edge-case inputs.
risks.description: Ethics risk: The AI system produces toxic, abusive or socially harmful outputs when prompted or under edge-case inputs. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Erosion of customer trust through unethical automation
risks.summary: Opaque or manipulative AI interactions undermine confidence in the institution's use of automated decision-making.
risks.description: Ethics risk: Opaque or manipulative AI interactions undermine confidence in the institution's use of automated decision-making. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Conflict with organisational values or conduct standards
risks.summary: AI behaviour or recommended actions diverge from the firm's stated ethical principles and code of conduct.
risks.description: Ethics risk: AI behaviour or recommended actions diverge from the firm's stated ethical principles and code of conduct. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Third-party model and tooling supply-chain risk
risks.summary: Reliance on external model providers, APIs or data vendors creates gaps in accountability when failures occur.
risks.description: Accountability & Governance risk: Reliance on external model providers, APIs or data vendors creates gaps in accountability when failures occur. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Unclear ownership for AI decisions and outcomes
risks.summary: Roles and escalation paths for AI-driven decisions are undefined, delaying remediation when harm materialises.
risks.description: Accountability & Governance risk: Roles and escalation paths for AI-driven decisions are undefined, delaying remediation when harm materialises. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Insufficient documentation for audit and challenge
risks.summary: Decision logic, data lineage and model change history are inadequately recorded for internal or regulatory review.
risks.description: Accountability & Governance risk: Decision logic, data lineage and model change history are inadequately recorded for internal or regulatory review. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Governance structures not scaled to AI complexity
risks.summary: Existing risk committees and approval workflows do not cover agentic or generative AI deployment patterns.
risks.description: Accountability & Governance risk: Existing risk committees and approval workflows do not cover agentic or generative AI deployment patterns. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Over-reliance on AI-generated outputs
risks.summary: Staff or customers accept AI recommendations without adequate verification, amplifying errors and compliance gaps.
risks.description: Transparency risk: Staff or customers accept AI recommendations without adequate verification, amplifying errors and compliance gaps. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Inadequate disclosure of AI involvement to customers
risks.summary: Users are not clearly informed when they interact with or are assessed by an AI system.
risks.description: Transparency risk: Users are not clearly informed when they interact with or are assessed by an AI system. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Limited explainability for high-impact decisions
risks.summary: Material credit, fraud or eligibility decisions cannot be explained in terms customers or regulators can understand.
risks.description: Transparency risk: Material credit, fraud or eligibility decisions cannot be explained in terms customers or regulators can understand. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Intellectual property and content-licence infringement
risks.summary: Training data or generated outputs may infringe third-party copyrights, licences or contractual use restrictions.
risks.description: Legal & Regulatory risk: Training data or generated outputs may infringe third-party copyrights, licences or contractual use restrictions. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Non-compliance with sector AI and data-protection rules
risks.summary: Deployment or data handling fails to meet applicable financial-sector, privacy or AI-specific regulatory requirements.
risks.description: Legal & Regulatory risk: Deployment or data handling fails to meet applicable financial-sector, privacy or AI-specific regulatory requirements. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Cross-border data-transfer and residency violations
risks.summary: Model training or inference processes data across jurisdictions without required safeguards or approvals.
risks.description: Legal & Regulatory risk: Model training or inference processes data across jurisdictions without required safeguards or approvals. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Inadequate contract terms with AI vendors
risks.summary: Third-party agreements lack clarity on liability, data use, model-change notification and regulatory cooperation.
risks.description: Legal & Regulatory risk: Third-party agreements lack clarity on liability, data use, model-change notification and regulatory cooperation. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Hallucination and factually incorrect outputs
risks.summary: Generative models produce confident but false statements that could mislead staff or customers.
risks.description: Robustness & Stability risk: Generative models produce confident but false statements that could mislead staff or customers. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Performance degradation under input distribution shift
risks.summary: Model accuracy falls when production data diverges from the training distribution.
risks.description: Robustness & Stability risk: Model accuracy falls when production data diverges from the training distribution. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Fragility to adversarial or edge-case inputs
risks.summary: Small perturbations or unusual inputs cause large, unpredictable changes in model behaviour.
risks.description: Robustness & Stability risk: Small perturbations or unusual inputs cause large, unpredictable changes in model behaviour. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Agentic workflow runaway or unintended tool use
risks.summary: Autonomous agents execute unplanned sequences of actions beyond the intended operational boundary.
risks.description: Robustness & Stability risk: Autonomous agents execute unplanned sequences of actions beyond the intended operational boundary. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Training or inference data privacy leakage
risks.summary: Sensitive customer or proprietary data is exposed through model memorisation, logs or prompt handling.
risks.description: Cyber & Data Security risk: Sensitive customer or proprietary data is exposed through model memorisation, logs or prompt handling. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Prompt injection and model manipulation attacks
risks.summary: Adversarial prompts override system instructions or extract confidential context from the model.
risks.description: Cyber & Data Security risk: Adversarial prompts override system instructions or extract confidential context from the model. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Insecure integration with internal systems and APIs
risks.summary: AI components connect to core banking systems without adequate authentication, authorisation or monitoring.
risks.description: Cyber & Data Security risk: AI components connect to core banking systems without adequate authentication, authorisation or monitoring. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

risks.title: Insufficient secrets and credential management for AI pipelines
risks.summary: API keys, model endpoints and data-store credentials are shared or stored without rotation and access controls.
risks.description: Cyber & Data Security risk: API keys, model endpoints and data-store credentials are shared or stored without rotation and access controls. Institutions should identify, assess and mitigate this risk through applicable MindForge Practices and operational controls.

mitigations.title: Define board AI accountability
mitigations.summary: Set clear board and senior-management accountability for AI strategy, material deployments and risk appetite.

mitigations.title: Review periodic AI risk reports
mitigations.summary: Receive structured reporting on AI risks, incidents, model changes and control effectiveness at least quarterly.
mitigations.description: Consideration C1 — Board and Senior Management Oversight. Receive structured reporting on AI risks, incidents, model changes and control effectiveness at least quarterly.

MindForge Consideration: C1 — Board and Senior Management Oversight

mitigations.title: Approve high-impact AI initiatives
mitigations.summary: Escalate and approve AI use cases with significant customer, financial or reputational impact before production.
mitigations.description: Consideration C1 — Board and Senior Management Oversight. Escalate and approve AI use cases with significant customer, financial or reputational impact before production.

MindForge Consideration: C1 — Board and Senior Management Oversight

mitigations.title: Establish enterprise AI governance framework
mitigations.summary: Document the end-to-end governance structure covering traditional, generative and agentic AI across the organisation.
mitigations.description: Consideration C2 — AI Governance Framework and Structure. Document the end-to-end governance structure covering traditional, generative and agentic AI across the organisation.

MindForge Consideration: C2 — AI Governance Framework and Structure

mitigations.title: Integrate AI into enterprise risk management
mitigations.summary: Align AI governance with existing ERM, operational risk and technology risk frameworks.
mitigations.description: Consideration C2 — AI Governance Framework and Structure. Align AI governance with existing ERM, operational risk and technology risk frameworks.

MindForge Consideration: C2 — AI Governance Framework and Structure

mitigations.title: Define AI governance forums and escalation paths
mitigations.summary: Create committees or working groups with mandates, membership and decision rights for AI matters.
mitigations.description: Consideration C2 — AI Governance Framework and Structure. Create committees or working groups with mandates, membership and decision rights for AI matters.

MindForge Consideration: C2 — AI Governance Framework and Structure

mitigations.title: Maintain AI policy suite
mitigations.summary: Publish and maintain policies covering acceptable AI use, data handling, model risk and third-party AI services.
mitigations.description: Consideration C3 — Policies, Standards and Procedures. Publish and maintain policies covering acceptable AI use, data handling, model risk and third-party AI services.

mitigations.title: Set technical standards for AI development
mitigations.summary: Define minimum standards for data quality, model validation, security and documentation across AI lifecycles.
mitigations.description: Consideration C3 — Policies, Standards and Procedures. Define minimum standards for data quality, model validation, security and documentation across AI lifecycles.

mitigations.title: Keep policies current with regulatory change
mitigations.summary: Review and update AI policies when regulations, supervisory guidance or material incidents occur.
mitigations.description: Consideration C3 — Policies, Standards and Procedures. Review and update AI policies when regulations, supervisory guidance or material incidents occur.

mitigations.title: Assign three-lines AI responsibilities
mitigations.summary: Clarify first-, second- and third-line roles for AI development, independent challenge and audit.
mitigations.description: Consideration C4 — Roles, Responsibilities and Competency. Clarify first-, second- and third-line roles for AI development, independent challenge and audit.

mitigations.title: Build AI literacy and specialist skills
mitigations.summary: Provide role-based training so staff understand AI capabilities, limits and escalation triggers.
mitigations.description: Consideration C4 — Roles, Responsibilities and Competency. Provide role-based training so staff understand AI capabilities, limits and escalation triggers.

mitigations.title: Define model owner and validator roles
mitigations.summary: Assign accountable owners and independent validators for each material AI model in production.
mitigations.description: Consideration C4 — Roles, Responsibilities and Competency. Assign accountable owners and independent validators for each material AI model in production.

mitigations.title: Maintain AI use-case inventory
mitigations.summary: Catalog all AI systems in development and production, including third-party and embedded models.
mitigations.description: Consideration C5 — AI Risk Identification. Catalog all AI systems in development and production, including third-party and embedded models.

mitigations.title: Apply taxonomy-based risk identification
mitigations.summary: Map each use case to the MindForge risk taxonomy dimensions and document inherent risks.
mitigations.description: Consideration C5 — AI Risk Identification. Map each use case to the MindForge risk taxonomy dimensions and document inherent risks.

mitigations.title: Scan for emerging AI threat patterns
mitigations.summary: Monitor industry incidents, red-team findings and threat intelligence relevant to deployed AI types.
mitigations.description: Consideration C5 — AI Risk Identification. Monitor industry incidents, red-team findings and threat intelligence relevant to deployed AI types.

mitigations.title: Assess inherent and residual AI risk
mitigations.summary: Evaluate likelihood and impact of identified risks before and after controls for each material use case.
mitigations.description: Consideration C6 — AI Risk Assessment and Measurement. Evaluate likelihood and impact of identified risks before and after controls for each material use case.

MindForge Consideration: C6 — AI Risk Assessment and Measurement

mitigations.title: Quantify model performance and drift risk
mitigations.summary: Measure accuracy, stability and drift indicators against defined thresholds.
mitigations.description: Consideration C6 — AI Risk Assessment and Measurement. Measure accuracy, stability and drift indicators against defined thresholds.

MindForge Consideration: C6 — AI Risk Assessment and Measurement

mitigations.title: Document risk assessment conclusions
mitigations.summary: Record assessment outcomes, assumptions, limitations and sign-off for audit and regulatory review.
mitigations.description: Consideration C6 — AI Risk Assessment and Measurement. Record assessment outcomes, assumptions, limitations and sign-off for audit and regulatory review.

MindForge Consideration: C6 — AI Risk Assessment and Measurement

mitigations.title: Pre-deployment fairness evaluation
mitigations.summary: Evaluate model outcomes across customer segments and document fairness findings prior to release.
mitigations.description: Consideration C7 — Model Development & Validation. Evaluate model outcomes across customer segments and document fairness findings prior to release.

mitigations.title: Robustness and stability testing
mitigations.summary: Test model behaviour under distribution shift and document robustness findings prior to release.
mitigations.description: Consideration C7 — Model Development & Validation. Test model behaviour under distribution shift and document robustness findings prior to release.

mitigations.title: Independent model validation
mitigations.summary: Subject material models to independent validation covering methodology, data and implementation integrity.
mitigations.description: Consideration C7 — Model Development & Validation. Subject material models to independent validation covering methodology, data and implementation integrity.

mitigations.title: Define data governance for AI datasets
mitigations.summary: Establish ownership, quality criteria and lineage for training, validation and production data.
mitigations.description: Consideration C8 — Data Management. Establish ownership, quality criteria and lineage for training, validation and production data.

mitigations.title: Control data access and retention
mitigations.summary: Restrict access to sensitive data used in AI pipelines and enforce retention and deletion rules.
mitigations.description: Consideration C8 — Data Management. Restrict access to sensitive data used in AI pipelines and enforce retention and deletion rules.

mitigations.title: Assess third-party training data provenance
mitigations.summary: Verify licensing, consent and quality of external data used to train or fine-tune models.
mitigations.description: Consideration C8 — Data Management. Verify licensing, consent and quality of external data used to train or fine-tune models.

mitigations.title: Gate production release on control evidence
mitigations.summary: Require documented validation, security review and approval before deploying models to production.
mitigations.description: Consideration C9 — Model Deployment and Release. Require documented validation, security review and approval before deploying models to production.

mitigations.title: Manage staged rollout and canary releases
mitigations.summary: Deploy material model changes through phased rollout with rollback criteria.
mitigations.description: Consideration C9 — Model Deployment and Release. Deploy material model changes through phased rollout with rollback criteria.

mitigations.title: Version and track deployed models
mitigations.summary: Maintain a registry of production model versions, parameters and deployment environments.
mitigations.description: Consideration C9 — Model Deployment and Release. Maintain a registry of production model versions, parameters and deployment environments.

mitigations.title: Monitor ongoing model performance
mitigations.summary: Track accuracy, latency, drift and business KPIs against defined tolerances in production.
mitigations.description: Consideration C10 — Model Monitoring and Performance. Track accuracy, latency, drift and business KPIs against defined tolerances in production.

mitigations.title: Detect data and concept drift
mitigations.summary: Alert when input distributions or outcome patterns shift materially from validation baselines.
mitigations.description: Consideration C10 — Model Monitoring and Performance. Alert when input distributions or outcome patterns shift materially from validation baselines.

mitigations.title: Review monitoring alerts and remediate
mitigations.summary: Investigate threshold breaches, document root cause and implement corrective actions promptly.
mitigations.description: Consideration C10 — Model Monitoring and Performance. Investigate threshold breaches, document root cause and implement corrective actions promptly.

mitigations.title: Control model change management
mitigations.summary: Require impact assessment, re-validation and approval for material model or data changes.
mitigations.description: Consideration C11 — Model Change and Retirement. Require impact assessment, re-validation and approval for material model or data changes.

mitigations.title: Plan safe model retirement
mitigations.summary: Decommission obsolete models with data archival, dependency mapping and customer communication where needed.
mitigations.description: Consideration C11 — Model Change and Retirement. Decommission obsolete models with data archival, dependency mapping and customer communication where needed.

mitigations.title: Preserve audit trail across model versions
mitigations.summary: Retain validation records, approval evidence and performance history for retired models.
mitigations.description: Consideration C11 — Model Change and Retirement. Retain validation records, approval evidence and performance history for retired models.

mitigations.title: Design meaningful human oversight points
mitigations.summary: Define where human review, override or escalation is required for AI-assisted decisions.
mitigations.description: Consideration C12 — Human-AI Interaction and Oversight. Define where human review, override or escalation is required for AI-assisted decisions.

mitigations.title: Train users on AI limitations
mitigations.summary: Ensure operators understand when to challenge, override or escalate AI recommendations.
mitigations.description: Consideration C12 — Human-AI Interaction and Oversight. Ensure operators understand when to challenge, override or escalate AI recommendations.

mitigations.title: Monitor human-AI override patterns
mitigations.summary: Analyse override rates and reasons to detect model issues or training gaps.
mitigations.description: Consideration C12 — Human-AI Interaction and Oversight. Analyse override rates and reasons to detect model issues or training gaps.

mitigations.title: Assess third-party AI providers
mitigations.summary: Due-diligence vendors on model governance, security, data use and regulatory compliance.
mitigations.description: Consideration C13 — Third-Party and Outsourcing Management. Due-diligence vendors on model governance, security, data use and regulatory compliance.

mitigations.title: Contract for model-change notification
mitigations.summary: Require vendors to notify the firm of material model updates affecting behaviour or risk.
mitigations.description: Consideration C13 — Third-Party and Outsourcing Management. Require vendors to notify the firm of material model updates affecting behaviour or risk.

mitigations.title: Monitor outsourced AI service performance
mitigations.summary: Track SLA, incident and control effectiveness for critical third-party AI dependencies.
mitigations.description: Consideration C13 — Third-Party and Outsourcing Management. Track SLA, incident and control effectiveness for critical third-party AI dependencies.

mitigations.title: Define AI incident taxonomy and playbooks
mitigations.summary: Classify AI-related incidents and maintain response procedures aligned with operational resilience.
mitigations.description: Consideration C14 — Incident Management and Response. Classify AI-related incidents and maintain response procedures aligned with operational resilience.

mitigations.title: Escalate material AI incidents promptly
mitigations.summary: Report significant AI failures, bias events or security breaches through established channels.
mitigations.description: Consideration C14 — Incident Management and Response. Report significant AI failures, bias events or security breaches through established channels.

mitigations.title: Conduct post-incident review and remediation
mitigations.summary: Analyse root cause, customer impact and control gaps after material AI incidents.
mitigations.description: Consideration C14 — Incident Management and Response. Analyse root cause, customer impact and control gaps after material AI incidents.

mitigations.title: Disclose AI use to affected customers
mitigations.summary: Inform customers when AI materially influences decisions or interactions, per regulatory expectations.
mitigations.description: Consideration C15 — Communication and Transparency. Inform customers when AI materially influences decisions or interactions, per regulatory expectations.

mitigations.title: Provide explainability for high-impact decisions
mitigations.summary: Offer understandable explanations or challenge routes for automated eligibility and risk decisions.
mitigations.description: Consideration C15 — Communication and Transparency. Offer understandable explanations or challenge routes for automated eligibility and risk decisions.

mitigations.title: Communicate AI limitations internally
mitigations.summary: Share known model limitations and prohibited use cases with business and operations teams.
mitigations.description: Consideration C15 — Communication and Transparency. Share known model limitations and prohibited use cases with business and operations teams.

mitigations.title: Schedule independent AI control testing
mitigations.summary: Include AI controls in internal audit plans proportional to materiality and risk.
mitigations.description: Consideration C16 — Audit and Independent Review. Include AI controls in internal audit plans proportional to materiality and risk.

mitigations.title: Test effectiveness of key AI controls
mitigations.summary: Verify that governance, validation and monitoring controls operate as designed.
mitigations.description: Consideration C16 — Audit and Independent Review. Verify that governance, validation and monitoring controls operate as designed.

mitigations.title: Track audit findings to closure
mitigations.summary: Remediate AI audit issues within agreed timelines and verify sustained fix.
mitigations.description: Consideration C16 — Audit and Independent Review. Remediate AI audit issues within agreed timelines and verify sustained fix.

mitigations.title: Monitor supervisory AI guidance
mitigations.summary: Track MAS, ABS and relevant authority guidance on AI risk and update controls accordingly.
mitigations.description: Consideration C17 — Regulatory Engagement and Reporting. Track MAS, ABS and relevant authority guidance on AI risk and update controls accordingly.

mitigations.title: Prepare regulatory AI risk reporting
mitigations.summary: Maintain evidence and metrics needed for supervisory inquiries and industry surveys.
mitigations.description: Consideration C17 — Regulatory Engagement and Reporting. Maintain evidence and metrics needed for supervisory inquiries and industry surveys.

mitigations.title: Engage regulators on material AI changes
mitigations.summary: Proactively discuss significant new AI deployments or incidents when supervisory dialogue is warranted.
mitigations.description: Consideration C17 — Regulatory Engagement and Reporting. Proactively discuss significant new AI deployments or incidents when supervisory dialogue is warranted.
